title: ICSI CS Executive June 2027 Registration: Don't Miss the November 30, 2026 Deadline!
content:
# ICSI CS Executive June 2027 Registration: Don't Miss the November 30, 2026 Deadline!

Ek important update hai for all CS Executive aspirants! The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne June 2027 session ke liye CS Executive Programme ki registrations open kar di hain.

Here are the key details you need to know:

*   **Registration Status:** Ongoing.
*   **Last Date for Both Modules:** If you plan to appear for both modules in the June 2027 examinations, make sure to complete your registration by **November 30, 2026**.
*   **Last Date for Single Module:** Candidates opting for a single module can register until **January 31, 2027**.
*   **Mode of Registration:** The registration process is entirely online through the official ICSI website.

Students jo CSEET qualified hain, ya graduates aur postgraduates direct entry route ke through eligible hain, woh apply kar sakte hain. Time rehte apni registration complete kar lena to avoid last-minute rush!

## Read the Official Document
*   [Visit the Official ICSI Website for Registration Details](https://www.icsi.edu/)

*Published on: 15 September 2026*
